analysis_approval_commit: The result applies to commit {commit}: the tree was clean and nothing that was analyzed changed during the run.
analysis_approval_snapshot: The result applies to commit {commit}, analyzed in a snapshot in the data folder.
analysis_approval_not_passed: The decision was {decision}: the result does not approve commit {commit}.
analysis_approval_dirty: The tree had local changes ({count} file(s)): the result applies to that state and does not approve the clean commit {commit}.
analysis_approval_dirty_unborn: The tree had local changes ({count} file(s)) and has no commit yet: the result applies only to that state.
analysis_approval_stale: {count} analyzed file(s) changed during the run: the result is out of date and is not attributed to any state. Run again.
analysis_approval_untraceable: The folder has more files than the manifest limit ({count} checked): the analyzed state is not fully traceable and the result does not approve a commit.
analysis_approval_no_git: Git was not found (set JGATES_GIT or put git on the PATH): the result applies to the folder contents, not to a commit.
analysis_approval_not_repository: The folder is not a Git repository: the result applies to its contents, not to a commit.
analysis_approval_unborn: The repository has no commit yet: the result applies to the folder contents, not to a commit.
analysis_text_target_commit: Analyzed: commit {commit}, in a snapshot in the data folder ({path}).
analysis_text_target_tree: Analyzed: the working tree at commit {commit}{dirty}.
analysis_text_target_directory: Analyzed: the folder as it is (no commit).
